mount.install: two halves lowered from the DP vessel and closed round the leg by a work-class ROV (Homarus), studs tensioned hydraulically after the leg is cleaned of growth under the liner; the garage on a bracket that takes out the leg's 1:10 batter so it lies level
mount.cp: bonded to the jacket's cathodic protection through the collars' bonding straps, plus two anodes on the garage

charger.kind: inductive coupler at the garage's back (no wet-mate pins)

patrol.note: a guard patrol at ~1 m/s round the jacket; intervention work (s['work_W']) empties it ~3x faster

cable.what: armoured hybrid cable up the leg in clamps: 2 single-mode fibres + 2 x 6 mm2 copper
cable.power: 400 V DC from the topside, 2.5 kW

data.docked: optical free-space modem at the coupler, ~100 Mbit/s over ~1 m: video and logs off, mission plans on
data.away: acoustic modem + USBL head on the dock: ~5-10 kbit/s to ~2 km, Squilla's position for the carrier and the topside
data.latency: fibre: ms; acoustic: ~1.5 s a km

docking.note: the mouth faces out from the jacket; a rotating tidal current crosses it twice a tide - docking waits for the cross component under the limit (North Sea tides at 80 m: ~0.3-0.6 m/s, assumed)
